functions.description: Battle scene element placement and fade update
functions.notes: Struct fix (Elem h0@0,b2@2,w4@4,w8@8), typed BattleView/GData views, flag2/ok init order and i declared before flag2 (i=r7, flag=r8) got the loop prologue and the TestBit/posVec sections to line up. Open: target recomputes i*12 after the Lookup call and builds b2 as (arr+2)+prod with e=arr+prod for ldmib {w4,w8}, ours keeps the product in a callee-saved reg (sb) so battle spills instead of ctx (frame 0x44 vs 0x40, push lacks r3 pad) and obj lands in r4 not sl. Tried: unsigned cast on index, base[i*12+2], (base+2)[i*12], local Vec2i struct copy, x/y preloads, colorsweep --apply (iroalign:data_020fdc4c, uncast) which only removed the ushort truncation the target keeps (lsl/lsr #16), aligned(4) on data_020fdc4c (IRO off gives mla not mul+add). 29 gate runs, no reduction in the last 10.
